title.narrative: SSD011N South Sudan Joint Response 2020

description.promeva:title: Description (English)
description.narrative: CARE in partnership with HDC and UNIDOR implements SSJR6 project in Jaak, Kuachlual and Gany Payams of Koch County-Unity State, focusing on food security and livelihoods, protection and Nutrition. The project provides emergency livelihood inputs, VSLA and IGA training, nutrition services (prevention and response), and community-based psycho-social services including awarenessraising on GBV, GBV case management and Menstrual Hygiene Management. Multi-purpose cash is provided as well.
Actually Koch but that location is not listed and Rubkona is close.

comment.narrative: 100% OTP/TSFP Nutrition centers are functional for nutrition treatment. All the 3 centers are providing life-saving service both preventive and curative. The nutrition programme was implemented in line with the MOH National CMAM guideline and its three CMAM components: Community outreach, Outpatient Therapeutic Programme (OTP) and Targeted Supplementary Feeding Progra
All three planned nutrition centers were established and are functional.

The 3 nutrition centers (100%) of Petpet, Jahjah and Bang are operating normally with components of CMAM such as the community mobilisation, Supplementary Feedsing progrmme (SFP) for TSFP specifically and OTP for the treatment of the SAM without Medical complications, passed the appetite test and clinically alert. comment.narrative: 40% of target beneficiaries have been reached to date with menstrual cups.

All targeted women and girls received the MHM cups at Petpet, Jahjah, Koat and Bang Bomas. Some the beneficiaries are school girls from Koch girls primary school and Kuachlual primary school.
